Title: Illusions of the Kindred + Hidden lurker

Messages.Author: ViniFace
Messages.Body:
Hi all, I was just wondering if i can play Hidden Lurker after Illusions of Kindred played by my active minion, and if so how does it works?

Hidden Lurker says that i can play the card only after a combat between the acting minion and the blocking one.
So, if I play Illusions and Lurker:
1) does the combat end and immediatly starts the combat with the Hidden Lurker minion? or
2) combat ends, start another combat with the crypt card and eventually after this combat, start the combat with the Hidden Lurker minion? or
3) it's not possible to play Hidden Lurker at all.

Thank you all for attention.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
You can't queue multiples combats.

So, once you play Illusion of the kindred, you can't play Lurker before the combat illusion <-> blocker, and after that combat, you still can't play Hidden Lurker because the illusion weren't an active minion.

Messages.Author: ViniFace
Messages.Body: as i thought. thank you very much for been quick and clear
